0x080000cc.name: __main
0x080000cc.role: ARM C library entry: SP=0x20000420, then __scatterload (Keil/armcc-style startup)

0x080000f2.name: Default_Handler
0x080000f2.role: b . infinite loop; used by ALL 32 peripheral IRQ vectors (no peripheral interrupts used)

0x080000fc.name: __scatterload
0x080000fc.role: walks region table 0x08001118..0x08001137 and calls copy/zero handlers, then main

0x0800012c.name: SysTick_Config
0x0800012c.role: CMSIS: LOAD=ticks-1, prio(SysTick)=3, VAL=0, CTRL=7; returns 1 if ticks>0x1000000

0x0800018c.name: SystemInit
0x0800018c.role: GD32 SystemInit: IRC8M on, reset RCU cfg, system_clock_config(), VTOR=0x08000000

0x08000238.name: NVIC_SetPriority
0x08000238.role: CMSIS ARMv8-M baseline (2 prio bits, <<6); IPR for IRQn>=0, SHPR for system exceptions

0x080002c0.name: adc_calibration_enable
0x080002c0.role: ADC_CTL1 RSTCLB(bit3) then CLB(bit2), busy-wait each

0x080002f8.name: adc_channel_length_config
0x080002f8.role: group 1 (routine): ADC_RSQ0[23:20]=len-1; group 2 branch writes ADC+0x38 (SPL inserted-group code, dead here)

0x08000360.name: adc_init_PA3
0x08000360.role: ADC clock (APB2EN.ADCEN), ADC clk=APB2/6, PA3 analog, continuous, SW trigger, right-align, 1 ch, CH3 rank0 239.5cyc, 12-bit, ADC on, 1 ms, calibrate

0x08000420.name: adc_external_trigger_config
0x08000420.role: ADC_CTL1.ETERC (bit20) for group bit0; bit15 for group bit1 (dead branch)

0x0800053c.name: adc_regular_channel_config
0x0800053c.role: RSQ0/1/2 rank slot = channel; SAMPT0/1 sample time

0x080006f4.name: adc_special_function_config
0x080006f4.role: SM (CTL0 bit8) / bit10 / CTN (CTL1 bit1); called with 2 => continuous mode ON

0x080007b0.name: pb1_write
0x080007b0.role: arg!=0: GPIOB_BOP=1<<1 (PB1 high) else GPIOB_BC=1<<1 (PB1 low)

0x080007d8.name: pa3_low_voltage_check
0x080007d8.role: avg10(ADC CH3) <= 1985 (0x7C1) ? {PB1 high; PA7 high; return 1} : return 0

0x08000814.name: delay_ms
0x08000814.role: g_delay=ms; spin until SysTick ISR decrements to 0

0x0800084c.name: adc_read_ch3
0x0800084c.role: rank0=CH3 @7.5cyc, SW trigger, clear EOC, poll EOC (timeout 1,000,000), return ADC_RDATA or -1

0x08000904.name: gpio_outputs_init
0x08000904.role: clk GPIOA+GPIOB; PA4 out pd, PB1 out pd, PA7 out, PA6 in floating; PA4/PB1/PA7 push-pull 50MHz; drive PA4, PB1, PA7 low

0x080009d2.name: gpio_mode_set
0x080009d2.role: GPIOx_CTL 2-bit mode + GPIOx_PUD 2-bit pull per selected pin

0x08000af8.name: button_pa1_init
0x08000af8.role: clk GPIOA + SYSCFG(CFGCMP); PA1 input with pull-up

0x08000b18.name: pa1_is_high
0x08000b18.role: return PA1 level (1 = released / pulled up)

0x08000b40.name: led_pa2_init
0x08000b40.role: clk GPIOA; PA2 output push-pull 50MHz; PA2 high

0x08000b98.name: main
0x08000b98.role: soft-power state machine: standby/wait button -> power on -> monitor button + PA3 voltage

0x08000dec.name: rcu_adc_clock_config
0x08000dec.role: switch(0..9) via PC-relative branch table @0x08000E20; called with 6 => ADCPSC=APB2/6, ADCSEL=1

0x08000fc4.name: system_clock_72m_irc8m
0x08000fc4.role: IRC8M on (timeout 0x500, hang if fail), FMC_WS=2WS, PLL=IRC8M/2 x18=72MHz, SCS=PLL, wait SCSS
